name: Chelsea Identity Authority v2.0 — HARDENED STAGED

parameters.content:
## PostgreSQL-only immutable identity authority v2
Only the trusted numeric Telegram actor ID and mutable username alias enter the authority. PostgreSQL derives principalKey, principalUuid, storage namespace, tenant, Qdrant collection and soulId atomically. No n8n Data Table participates in runtime identity resolution.
